column1: # The box's cells for a bloomery release sitting (tools/release/sitting.sh in the bloomery tree documents the columns).
# Copy it per release as cells-<version>.tsv, edit the files, and name the copy to sit.sh (--cells).
# One row is one served configuration: the model profile and file, the placement, the cards, the timed depths and
# round 1's first-request checks (pass_checks.py arguments). `a` is the RTX 3090 alone and `bp` both cards (the A6000
# `a` rows of earlier releases are dropped). ctx is empty everywhere: the serving default, the largest step the machine
# holds, read back from the plan record into every row label. The cells of one file sit together, `bp` before `a`.
# load_s, pp and tg only price the predicted wall: the means of 0.3.10's own rows (two rounds, D 512 and 4096, ctx 4300)
# [measured]; a load at the unset context may differ. Flint has no model profile (tools/ref/models/), so it has no cell.
